paper_title: Constraints on axion-like particles from X-ray observations of Hydra galaxy cluster
notes: Wouters & Brun (2013) constrain the ALP-photon coupling using Chandra X-ray spectra of Hydra A in the Hydra cluster magnetic field (Faraday-rotation-measured, conservative theta=30deg profile). The headline result is a mass-independent bound g_agamma < 8.3e-12 GeV^-1 (95% CL) for m_a < 7e-12 eV; encoded here as a flat line from very low mass up to 7e-12 eV. Points above 7e-12 eV are approximate reconstructions of Figure 4: a slightly weaker exclusion near m_a ~ 8e-12 eV (where m_a ~ effective plasma photon mass) and a rise proportional to m_a^2 at higher masses, valid up to ~2e-11 eV. Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumption.
